# Recrutement, editions 1922-1924 and 1926-1929 (same format as recruitment.txt).
# Read from the native-resolution page images (hires.py). Each edition prints the French
# tables on one page and the indigenous tables on the facing page; the windows are those
# printed in the table headings (e.g. "(1913-1922)"). Readings that differ from other
# printings, and doubtful glyphs, are listed in the notes of each CSV.
# sgt1926 fr_board 1919 postponed: the second digit is a broken glyph (a bare stroke, no
# flag or foot as on this font's 1); read as 54 like every other printing (the row
# identity of sgt1926 itself also needs 54).
